verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (the self-service Contract Generator, the GDHQ records platform, and the D&O Questionnaire Portal), so a bulk-operations question is a fair one to ask. None of the evidence describes acting on many items at once, such as batch contract generation or bulk record updates. ChatGD's document querying is an internal attorney tool and shows no batch capability, and the probes found no published API (llms.txt and OpenAPI paths return 404).
